title: Young Tuxedo band under Duck Winnie, with Kid Rena
summary: Lee joins the Young Tuxedo band, where the leader drops Kid Rena to keep Lee away from whiskey, then returns to Carey's band.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: You heard of that band? Yeah, they still have one.

It was run by a bass player called Duck Winnie's. So Duck Winnie's had another cornet player in the band, it was Kid Rene. So he was using two cornets, Kid Rene and myself. He was never awful, but powerful cornet player, played very high at that time. So Duck said, Lee, I'm going to leave Rene go because Rene is getting to drinking too much and I think he's going to spoil you and start you drinking. I never was a guy who could drink much whiskey. Anyway, at the time a few drinks I drank, it always made me sick. And it showed up in my plane. So they got rid of Rene so I could get the whiskey away from me. So I played around, played around, played around. So I leaves Duck Winnie's band again and goes back to Jack Kerrie's band because Jack Kerrie had got that job where Joe Oliver and O'Rehead was playing. I grabbed him in Ramport called the Winter Garden. There'd be a place up there. Did you hear about that place? Upstairs.
